fusions.name: Epicentre
fusions.desc: Strikes the ground, dealing 30 earth damage to every enemy within 4 tiles, ignoring their armour, and leaving them [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Spreading Fracture
fusions.desc: A blow that deals 14 rock damage and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Tremor Underfoot
fusions.desc: After a 1-second wind-up, the ground shakes and holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Quarryman's Read
fusions.desc: Your physical attacks ignore 20% of the target's armour.
